verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Rootly offers both public and private status pages ('two types of status pages available: public status pages and private status pages') aimed at internal stakeholders vs external customers, which directly supports the story. However, there is no evidence detailing granular access control mechanisms (e.g., SSO/role-based restriction, audience-specific authentication) for private pages beyond the existence of the private page type. Missing for 10: documentation on access-control mechanisms (SSO, password protection, audience segmentation), independent/hands-on confirmation of private page usage.
